name: Praises
overview: Scripture calls believers to express heartfelt praises to the LORD with joyful noise and singing, recognizing praise as both good and pleasant before God. The psalms repeatedly exhort praising God from all places—earth, heavens, and His sanctuary—emphasizing praise as a fitting and powerful response to His greatness. Additionally, James highlights that praise through singing is appropriate in times of joy, linking praise with prayer in all circumstances.
